species: The peptide spectra were searched against the P. falciparum database to identify proteins associated with PfMed31.
tissue: 6 mL of infected blood (>10% parasitemia, 2% hematocrit) was harvested for the experiment.
cell_type: To detect the association of other Mediator proteins with PfMed31, we generated a parasite line, Med31-HA, that expresses hemagglutinin-tagged PfMed31 from an episomal vector.
disease_state: The genome of the human malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum has been predicted to encode several Mediator subunits.
sample_source: 6 mL of infected blood (>10% parasitemia, 2% hematocrit) was harvested for the experiment.
strain: Western blot of parasite protein lysates with anti-HA antibody revealed the expression of PfMed31-HA protein (∼19 kDa) in the Med31-HA strain and not in the wild-type T996 parent
